text: We evaluated bootstrapping through an intermediate-size model, using pythia-410m as the weak supervisor, pythia-1b as the intermediate step, and qwen2.5-7b as the strong student. The run used num_seeds = 1, so all figures below come from a single seed and should be read as preliminary. The weak supervisor reached 0.58 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling was 0.83, while the bootstrapped transfer accuracy was 0.61 with a standard error of 0.01. The resulting performance gap recovered (PGR) was 0.11 with a standard error of 0.06, against a baseline PGR of 0.27. The bootstrapped PGR therefore falls below the baseline rather than above it, so this configuration shows no evidence of a gain from the intermediate-model pipeline; with one seed and a PGR standard error of 0.06, the comparison cannot support any strong directional claim either way. Replication across additional seeds would be needed before drawing conclusions about the method.
